IntercomOAuthCredential.description:
OAuth 2.0 credential for Intercom (public app, authorization_code flow).

Tokens are obtained via the OAuth flow ("Connect Intercom account"), not
entered manually. Intercom access tokens are LONG-LIVED — they never expire
and there is no refresh token, so this credential intentionally carries no
``refresh_token`` / ``expires_at`` (nothing to rotate).

Register an OAuth app at: https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/developer-hub

access_token.description: Intercom OAuth access token (Bearer). Long-lived; never expires.
access_token.title: Access Token

region.title: Region

IntercomOAuthCredential.title: IntercomOAuthCredential
IntercomOAuthCredential.x-oauth-custom-client-help: Optionally bring your own Intercom OAuth app. Create one in the Intercom Developer Hub, open Configure > Authentication, add NoClick's Intercom callback as a redirect URL, enable the scopes above, and paste its Client ID and Secret here. Leave blank to use NoClick's shared Intercom app.
